articles.summary: MOUNTLAKE TERRACE, Wash. , Dec. 23, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FS Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSBW), the holding company for 1st Security Bank of Washington (“1st Security” or “Bank”) announces Omeed Salashoor’s appointment as Senior Vice President, Director of Home Lending.
articles.title: 1st Security Bank Announces Omeed Salashoor as new Director of Home Lending
